title: A Coprimality Topology on the Gaussian Integers: Kolmogorov Quotient and Gaussian Prime Density
summary: This article investigates the coprimality topology on the set of non-zero Gaussian integers, $\mathbb{Z}[i]\setminus\{0\}$, generated by the arithmetic basis $σ_α=\{β\neq 0 : \gcd(α,β)\sim 1\}$. By analyzing prime supports up to associates, we establish that two points are topologically indistinguishable if and only if their supports coincide.
